links.comparator_used: Open-ended inquiry prompt (free-text output) vs structured template prompt, same models and 30 IPC scenarios
links.outcome: Expert-rated composite quality, mainly evidence quality (1-10 scales rated by 16 experts)
links.effect: Structured prompting yielded significant improvements, primarily by enhancing evidence quality (p < 0.001)
links.tradeoff: Gemini 2.5 Pro Exp failed to generate responses in 50% of scenarios under structured prompt conditions; qualitative review found critical deficiencies across all models.
links.quote: Structured prompting yielded significant improvements, primarily by enhancing evidence quality (p < 0.001).
